name: Blank Custom
goals: Provide a neutral but playable ECHO pack scaffold
Show where missions, Index pages, TutorialCore hints, and HoloMap layers belong
Keep every piece easy to replace with creator-owned content
description: A guided Blank Custom starter with Core, NetCore, Index, TutorialCore, MissionCore, and HoloMap scaffolds plus one replaceable first-session loop.
targetPlayer: Creators who want a neutral ECHO pack shell that launches with one minimal, replaceable starter loop.
gameplayLoop: Open Index, read the blank-pack orientation, complete a tiny MissionCore checklist, view the starter HoloMap layer, and replace the sample content with the pack concept.
first30Minutes: Rename the sample Index page to match the pack concept.
Pick the first additional module or config preset.
Run pack validation after changing the scaffold.
first2Hours: Replace the sample mission with a real chapter objective.
Add one pack-specific Index entry and one tutorial hint.
Export and validate a client and server manifest.

wizardCopy.summary: A guided blank scaffold with Core, NetCore, Index, TutorialCore, MissionCore, and HoloMap selected so generated packs have a tiny playable loop.
warnings: All starter content is intentionally generic and should be renamed before publishing.

first10Minutes: Open Index and read the Blank Custom orientation page.
